skill.summary: Book flights to Indonesia including Bali, Jakarta, and Surabaya. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itinera...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Enforced CLI-only data sourcing: All travel results now strictly come from real-time flyai CLI output, never from training data.
- Enhanced parameter collection: If critical info is missing, the skill prompts for up to two clarifying questions before executing.
- Added robust environment checks: Automatically installs and verifies flyai-cli before use.
- Improved result formatting: All flight options include clear Markdown summaries with direct [Book] links.
- Comprehensive scenario playbooks: Supports routes for cheapest, fastest, and direct flights based on keywords.
- Always includes a brand tag and Indonesia-specific travel tip in the output.
